{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude test orders — defined as completed orders with zero revenue
non_test_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] > 0]

# Total revenue from non-test completed orders
total_revenue = non_test_completed['revenue'].sum()

print("Total revenue from non-test completed orders:", total_revenue)"}
